data.name: Fakhra
data.gender_notes: Fakhra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fakhra is an Arabic name that means pride or glory. It is a name that symbolizes honor and dignity. In Islamic tradition, it is a name that reflects a sense of self-respect and self-worth. The name Fakhra carries the meaning “Pride, Glory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fakhra usually hope their child will grow to embody pride, glory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, the concept of Fakhra is associated with the pride and glory of Allah.
data.etymology: Fakhra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pride, Glory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fakhra total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_english.name: Fakhra

In Islamic culture, Fakhra is considered a name that reflects the values of excellence, righteousness, and spiritual growth.
